name: orbit-dust
title: Orbit Dust
description: A GPU particle ring orbiting a dark core, bent by a gravity well under the pointer.

props.description: A figure with an accessible name that owns one Canvas. Size it with className.

props.name: ink
props.description: Ground tone. Any three.js color string.

props.name: paper
props.description: Light tone.

props.name: count
props.description: Particles, clamped to 50k–200k. Omit it to pick from hardwareConcurrency, devicePixelRatio and pointer type.

props.name: radius
props.description: Outer radius of the disc in world units. The camera frames 2.

props.name: thickness
props.description: Vertical spread of the disc.

props.name: turbulence
props.description: Curl-noise swirl. 0 gives clean orbits.

props.name: speed
props.description: Time scale of the orbits and the swirl.

props.name: paused
props.description: Holds the frame and stops rendering.

props.name: label
props.default: "A ring of dust orbiting a dark core"
props.description: Accessible name.

props.name: className
props.description: Give the disc a size.
Camera, core and dust without the Canvas. Mount it alone in a Canvas or a drei View.

props.name: ink
props.description: Ground tone. Any three.js color string.

props.name: paper
props.description: Light tone.

props.name: count
props.description: Particles. Changing it rebuilds the geometry.

props.name: radius
props.description: Outer radius.

props.name: thickness
props.description: Vertical spread.

props.name: turbulence
props.description: Curl-noise swirl.

props.name: speed
props.description: Time scale.

props.name: paused
props.description: Freezes time. The gravity well jumps instead of easing.

accessibility: A figure with an accessible name. The canvas is hidden from assistive tech.
Without WebGL it shows a static gradient ring in the same two tones.

animation.timing: Always while visible, on demand offscreen or paused

docs: Requires React 19. Render <OrbitDust className="aspect-video w-full" /> anywhere. OrbitDust owns a Canvas, so mount OrbitDustScene inside an existing Canvas or drei View when a page already has one.
